label: logos_and_branding
name: Logos and Branding Image Category Classification
description: Classify a non-OCR logo or branding image into one or more detailed categories based on its visual structure, use of text, symbols, emblems, characters, and brand context.

labels.wordmark: An image primarily showing a brand or organization name designed as a text-based logo.
labels.lettermark: An image primarily showing one or more initials or letters designed as a logo.
labels.symbol_logo: An image primarily showing a graphic symbol, icon, or pictorial mark representing a brand or organization.
labels.combination_logo: An image primarily showing both a brand name and a graphic symbol combined into one logo.
labels.emblem: An image primarily showing a logo enclosed inside a badge, shield, circle, crest, or similar shape.
labels.mascot_logo: An image primarily showing a character, animal, person, or illustrated mascot used to represent a brand.
labels.app_icon: An image primarily showing an icon used to represent a mobile application, software product, or digital service.
labels.brand_mark: An image primarily showing a standalone visual mark strongly associated with a brand.
labels.seal_or_badge: An image primarily showing an official seal, certification badge, institutional insignia, or organization badge.
labels.product_logo: An image primarily showing the logo or visual identity of a specific commercial product.
labels.corporate_logo: An image primarily showing the official logo or visual identity of a company or business.
labels.sports_logo: An image primarily showing the logo, crest, or emblem of a sports team, club, league, or competition.
labels.government_emblem: An image primarily showing an official government emblem, national symbol, department seal, or public authority insignia.
